title: Praise the Lord
truth: God is so good to us, giving us good things and forgiving our sins.
points: Praise God with all your heart.
Remember all the good things God does.
God forgives us and makes us new.
apply: Today, think of one good thing God has given you and thank Him for it.
prayer: God, thank You for loving me and forgiving my sins through Jesus. Help me to praise You today.
